title: Review of c07's metabolic-no-shell-needed finding: replicates on fresh seed 9 (no gate, Dc=0.01: 22 persistent splits, catalyst 24-39x with every body >= 2x; full world 25 splits); seed 8 blows up in both arms; Supported
summary: I re-ran world_nogate_Dc0.01.py and the full fch-metabolic world.py with labkit on new seed 8 and then seed 9 (100 frames x 400 steps, T=800; rerun/), and measured catalyst containment with c03's cargo_contrast.py (summary.txt). Seed 8 gives non-finite fields at frame 1 in both arms (seed8_blowup/), as seed 6 did for the author. Seed 9, no gate and Dc=0.01: bodies 41/41/46/49 at frames 25/50/75/100, 26 splits, 22 persistent, 0 merges, generation 2; catalyst lumen/outside contrast 38.9 at frame 50 and 23.9 at frame 100 with every body >= 2x (weakest 11.8x, 5.8x). Full gated world on seed 9: 24/40/51/58 bodies, 35 splits, 25 persistent, generation 2, contrast 55.7 and 116.5 with 94-97% of bodies >= 2x. The no-gate sheet shows micelles that nucleate, divide by dumbbell fission at t~136-240 and persist to t=800.

observations.E: rerun/ng9/sheet.png: without the gate, with the catalyst 100x slower, bodies persist and grow in number to t=800 (41 -> 49)
observations.D: rerun/ng9/lineage.png: 22 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges (full world: 25, generation 2)
observations.W: summary.txt: no-gate catalyst contrast 24-39x with every body >= 2x

seeds_run.result: fail: non-finite fields at frame 1 in both the twin and the full world

controls_run.E: rerun/full9 (full gated world, same seed) as the comparison arm

verdicts.limitation: One informative fresh seed; 2 of the 4 seeds tried across the author's and my runs (6 and 8) blow up at the first frame, so the explicit scheme is fragile from this noise start. The lowered-D twin starts with more bodies (41 vs 24 at frame 25) and ends with fewer (49 vs 58), so it is comparable, not identical. This finding qualifies the shell-needed finding (which I also reviewed as Supported): the shell is necessary at the world's own Dc, but a uniformly slower catalyst does the same job, so the boundary is not shown to do work beyond slowing diffusion.
